title: In 1994, a Comet Smashed Into Jupiter and Left a Scar Bigger Than Earth

scenes.text: In 1994, a comet smashed into Jupiter and left a scar bigger than Earth.
Jupiter's gravity had already torn it into 21 pieces. They hit one after another, for six days.
Each piece slammed in at 137,000 miles an hour.
The biggest exploded with 48 billion tons of TNT. More than every nuclear weapon on Earth combined.
It left a black bruise wider than our whole planet. Visible for weeks.
Jupiter took that hit for us. Without it, the comet might have been ours.

description:
In July 1994, the 21 fragments of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 slammed into Jupiter at about 137,000 miles an hour over six days.
The largest fragment, G, released energy equal to roughly 48 billion tons of TNT and left a dark cloud wider than Earth's diameter that stayed visible for weeks.
Would you rather watch an impact like this live or never know it happened?
first_comment: Jupiter's gravity is so strong it had already ripped the comet into 21 pieces two years before the crash. Do you think Jupiter protects Earth or just gets lucky?
